You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. Focused Step of the Wind: you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dash actions as a Bonus Action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

features:
=== MONK FEATURES ===

Martial Arts
You gain the following benefits when unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons, provided you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield: you can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action; you can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage from your Unarmed Strikes or Monk weapons; you can use Dex. instead of Str. for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk Weapons, and for the save DC of Grapple or Shove.

Unarmored Defense
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base AC equals 14.

Monk's Focus
You have 2 Focus Points and regain all expended points after a Short or Long Rest. Known features: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind. Save DC for these features = 8 + Wis. modifier + Prof. Bonus.

Unarmored Movement
Your speed increases by 10 ft. while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

Uncanny Metabolism
Once per Long Rest, when you roll Initiative you can regain all expended Focus Points and regain 1d6+2 HP.

=== WAY OF THE ASTRAL SELF ===

Forms of Your Astral Self
A monk who follows the Way of the Astral Self believes their body is an illusion. They see their ki as a representation of their true form, an astral self, which can be a force of order or disorder. The astral self is a translucent embodiment of the monk's soul and can reflect aspects of their background, ideals, flaws, and bonds — it doesn't necessarily look anything like the monk.

Arms of the Astral Self (3rd level)
As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Ki point to summon the arms of your astral self. Each creature of your choice you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take force damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die. The spectral arms hover near your shoulders or surround your arms (your choice), last 10 minutes, and vanish early if you are incapacitated or die.
While the arms are present: use your Wisdom modifier in place of Strength for Strength checks and saving throws; the arms can make unarmed strikes; an unarmed strike with the arms has 5 ft. greater reach; those unarmed strikes use Wisdom in place of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls, and deal force damage.

=== ELF SPECIES TRAITS ===

Creature Type
You are a Humanoid, and also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

Astral Fire
You know one of the following cantrips of your choice: dancing lights, light, or sacred flame. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

Darkvision
You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Colors in that darkness appear only as shades of gray.

Fey Ancestry
You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition on yourself.

Keen Senses
You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

Starlight Step
As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, all uses regained on a long rest.

Astral Trance
You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours in a trancelike meditation, remaining conscious throughout. On finishing this trance, you gain proficiency in one skill and one weapon or tool of your choice, retained until your next long rest.

Languages
Common and one other language agreed with your DM.
